name: heor-skills
summary: Open-source HEOR and medical device market-access skills for AI agents. Nine skills, a deterministic economic modeling engine, and six jurisdictional reimbursement databases (CH, DE, FR, US). Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI.

skills.name: regulation-navigator
skills.description: Maps a product to its reimbursement pathway across CH, DE, FR, US with prerequisites and timelines

skills.name: tariff-scout
skills.description: Searches official reimbursement lists for existing codes and comparable products

skills.name: prisma-review
skills.description: Runs a PRISMA 2020 systematic literature review: PICO, search, screening, diagram, synthesis

skills.name: economic-modeling
skills.description: Builds and runs cost-effectiveness and budget-impact models through a deterministic engine

skills.name: ch-migel-application
skills.description: Drafts a Swiss MiGeL (device list) application form

skills.name: ch-analysenliste-application
skills.description: Drafts a Swiss Analysenliste (laboratory test) application form

skills.name: ch-klv-forms
skills.description: Drafts Swiss KLV forms: Meldung, Antrag, Umstrittenheit

skills.name: eurhta-report
skills.description: Drafts a EUnetHTA Core Model HTA report chapter by chapter

skills.name: hta-quality-check
skills.description: Scores a draft against BAG rubrics and checks cross-section consistency

engine.name: @heor/engine
engine.description: Pure-TypeScript economic modeling engine with zero runtime dependencies
